game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove, a tidepool cove: the sailor must hold off rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove: a tidepool cove
core_gameplay_loop: In Tidepool Cove, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely. Then check stealth and advance.
player_objective: Protect the dock crane from rogue waves in Tidepool Cove: keep stealth above zero until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 3, Level 5, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
